caption: This black-and-white drawing contains an oval wreath formed by illustrated leaves in the upper left, enclosing a block of text that reads "A GIFT to the first CHURCH OF CHRIST in DERBY by N. FRENCH 1791." To the right of the wreath is a detailed front view of an architectural bracket or corbel with ornamental designs, including a rounded boss and linear accents. Below the wreath, there are three separate architectural elements: a circular medallion on the left, and two stylized capital-like objects in the center and right, each with fluted and decorated tops, but different in their shape and patterning. Near the bottom right corner, the name "Lawrence Flynn" is written in cursive script. The background is a cream or off-white color and all drawn elements and text are in black ink. The composition is organized with spacing between each object and the items grouped in logical relationship to one another.
title: Silver Flagon: Detail
